nodes.label: Decision: rules as pure functions over plain data (U2), composed by the reducer (U5)
nodes.rationale: All randomness uses the state's seeded Rng; screens only render state and dispatch actions.

nodes.label: Decision: one state, two layers (private/public), no status effects
Decision: the night is a list of screens built at dusk
nodes.rationale: 'Zurück' only moves the cursor, never undoes recorded data.

nodes.label: Decision: win detection sets winner, the flow decides when the teaser shows
Ambiguity rules (red herring, bluffs, starpass, Scarlet Woman, Mayor/Saint questions)
Decision: time is never read inside the reducer (timer carries now, seatMs in UI)
nodes.rationale: Tests never wait 30 s; e2e overrides window.clocktowerSeatMs.

nodes.label: Clocktower theme: tokens redefined under html[data-theme='clocktower'] + data-variant day/night
nodes.rationale: Shared components follow without edits; hooks.server.ts renders the attribute so reload shows no other theme first; a wrapper div would leave body and the shared header unthemed.

nodes.label: Decision: fonts and icons taken from Rue's presentation file
nodes.rationale: 22 single-path SVG icons stored as path data in characters.ts; IM Fell English (SC) and Alegreya Sans latin woff2 subsets with OFL texts.

nodes.label: Character sheet component (Sheet.svelte) placed on setup board and as last deck slide
nodes.rationale: Phone pages Gut/Böse scroll at 14px+ instead of fitting one screen (17 Gut entries only fit at 9.5px).

nodes.label: Decision: BotC e2e stays small and local (localStorage seeding, rules in vitest)
Sky motif (stars, moon, sun) in the deco backdrop
nodes.rationale: Visibility by html[data-variant] CSS only, so the variant morph animates it and no state reaches the decoration.

nodes.label: Circle.svelte seat circle contract (owned by U17)
nodes.rationale: Ten round-2 S-items land on the shared circle; one owner unit makes every Circle change in wave 1 behind props; later units only pass props.

nodes.label: Characters on the setup circle (Circle token prop, S41)
Decision: S44 navigation last, circle capped by viewport height (no sticky dock)
nodes.rationale: Rue chose circle and info in one piece with 'Weiter' at the end over the sticky dock; the 'measure primary action' learning applies as measuring, not pinning.
